parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. Specifies the current page number for paging queries.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The page size. Specifies the number of records per page for paging queries.

parameters.name: Phase
parameters.description:
The WAF rule execution phase. Valid values:
- http_whitelist: whitelist rules
- http_custom: custom rules
- http_managed: managed rules
- http_anti_scan: scan protection rules
- http_ratelimit: frequency control rules
- ip_access_rule: IP access rules
- http_bot: advanced mode bots
- http_security_level_rule: security rules

parameters.name: QueryArgs
parameters.description: The query parameters, passed in JSON format, including various filter conditions.

parameters.name: SiteId
parameters.description: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation to obtain the site ID.

parameters.name: SiteVersion
parameters.description: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0.
